name: Star Wars: Balance of the Force
source:
The game will take you on a fantastic journey playing a male human, who is trying to survive while the entire galaxy seems to start burning in the flames of a civil war. Will you try to join the newly formed underground or rather work towards clearing your name in the ranks of the legal government? Or maybe it won't be anything of the above and you try to make your own way?
Are you pragmatic?
Or do you stand for your ideals,
disregarding the possible consequences for you, and maybe anybody close to you?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/doubblenow]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在这段奇幻旅程中，你将扮演一名男性人类。当整个银河似乎都开始在内战的烈焰中燃烧时，他正努力求生。你会加入新成立的地下组织，还是留在合法政府的队伍中，设法洗清自己的罪名？又或者，两者皆非，而是走出属于自己的道路？
你是个务实的人吗？
还是会坚守理想，
不顾这可能给自己，甚至身边所有人带来的后果？

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/doubblenow]Patreon[/url]]
